newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices mostly steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices mostly steady to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady to lower Thursday in quiet activity ahead of the U.S. Memorial Day holiday weekend, dealers said.
Dealers cited tight nearby supplies spurred by reduced flour mill runtimes.
Flour mills will not be running Saturday, Sunday or Monday, a Buffalo dealer said.
"We see a very thin market between offers and bids. It looks like both sides are pretty well covered for the holiday," he said.
People were focusing on logistics, a St Louis dealer said.
Dealers also said that for the most part, most feed mixers and merchandisers have already covered their needs. "If you need to buy something, you have problems," one said.
Trading was light, a few truckloads here and there, according to a Minneapolis dealer said. "There isn't very much (supply) around anyway," the dealer added.
